Shakti Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13
August, 2024
Author: Saurabh Srivastava

Bench: Saurabh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:131795
Court No. - 83
Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 12869 of 2023
Appellant :- Shakti Singh And Another

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Appellant :- Manvendra Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Vipin Kumar
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1.
Heard Sri Manvendra Singh, learned counsel for the appellants and learned AGA for the State.
No one appeared on behalf of respondent no.2 even in the revised call.

2. The instant appeal has been preferred with a prayer to quash the summoning order dated 31.10.2023 passed by learned Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Fatehpur in F.R. Case No.363 of 2023 (Kunti Devi Vs. Shakti Singh and another), arising out of Case Crime No.96 of 2023, under Section 376-D, 506 IPC and Section 3(2)V of SC/ST Act, P.S. Chandpur, District Fatehpur and further prayer for quashing of the said case, pending the court of learned Special Judge, SC/ST Act,
Fatehpur.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for appellants pressed all the grounds whatsoever have been taken through the instant criminal appeal through which, it has been apprised that there is hardly any attraction of sections in which the appellants have been summoned and all these grounds have not been taken into consideration while passing the order dated 31.10.2023.

4. Per contra, learned AGA for the State vehemently opposed the prayer sought through the instant appeal on the ground that summoning order has been passed after considering the material available on record.

5. Be that as it may, no useful purpose will be served in keeping the matter pending by way of calling counter affidavit and rejoinder affidavit by the parties and as such, learned court concerned is hereby directed to expedite and finalize the proceedings of F.R. Case No.363 of 2023 (Kunti Devi Vs.
Shakti Singh and another), arising out of Case Crime No.96 of 2023, under Section 376-D, 506 IPC and Section 3(2)V of SC/ST Act, P.S. Chandpur, District Fatehpur, as expeditiously as possible,
preferably within a period of 12 months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order before him without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties but after giving full opportunity of hearing to both sides.
6. Learned counsel for appellants assures on behalf of the appellants that they will fully cooperate with the learned trial court concerned for expeditious disposal of the said case.
7.
